verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents an integrations catalog that syncs with "hundreds" (elsewhere "100+") of tools to automate evidence collection. The evidence touches several of the named categories: cloud providers (GDPR cloud checks, Azure Government monitoring), identity/SSO app detection, Jira ticketing sync, and native integrations for pulling user data. Custom integrations via API or CSV cover tools without a native connector. missing for 10: evidence of read-only or least-privilege scopes for connections, named HR, code hosting and MDM integrations, per-integration setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
